description: Defines test collection setup classes for AWSUtils.Tests, specifically for default cluster and test environment fixtures in unit testing with Xunit.

classes.name: DefaultClusterTestCollection
classes.description: Defines a test collection for tests that require a default Orleans cluster setup, sharing a single cluster instance.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentFixtureCollection
classes.description: Defines a test collection for tests requiring shared test environment configuration, including AWS-specific setup.

methods.name: DefaultClusterTestCollection
methods.description: Constructor for the DefaultClusterTestCollection class, but in this case it is an empty class implementing ICollectionFixture.

methods.name: TestEnvironmentFixtureCollection
methods.description: Constructor for the TestEnvironmentFixtureCollection class, also an empty class implementing ICollectionFixture.
